subject: Data handling pilot: next steps and scope
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@finserve.ai>, Lisa Morales <lisa@finserve.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Data handling pilot: next steps and scope

Hi Samir / Lisa —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap while it's fresh and proposed next steps so we can move the pilot forward.

What we covered (agreed during call):
- Objective: 4-week pilot to validate inference quality, latency, and privacy controls for FinServe Analytics’ customer-facing insights product.
- Data residency: pilot to use eu-west-1 region exclusively for processing and logs.
- Retention ask: FinServe requested a "0-retention" option for user free-text (no persisted request/response logs).
- Billing/telemetry: FinServe agreed that minimal billing telemetry and aggregated request metrics are acceptable; these should not include raw prompts.
- PII handling: FinServe requested field-level redaction/hash-only storage for any PII that must be persisted for troubleshooting.

Our proposed approach (we discussed alternatives on the call):
- Ephemeral mode for free-text generation: runtime-only KV/cache (TTL=0, not persisted to long-term storage) + no raw request bodies in logs.
- Short retention for operational logs: 7 days for request IDs, aggregated latency/cost counters; no full prompt text.
- Embeddings: by default embeddings are persisted for retrieval features; we can offer an opt-in 3-day retention for pilot if FinServe prefers no long-lived embeddings.
- Residency: dedicated eu-west-1 routing for pilot; if strict physical isolation is required, we may need Dedicated capacity (we'll follow up on cost).

Attachments: I’m attaching a short pilot MOP + a high-level ephemeral architecture diagram for your review (redwood-ephemeral-architecture.pdf, pilot-mop.xlsx).

Next steps (proposed):
1) FinServe confirms acceptance of hybrid retention plan (ephemeral free-text + 7-day telemetry).
2) We provide SOC2 summary and a short compliance evidence pack for procurement.
3) Agree kickoff date and SOW/PO template so procurement can issue an initial PO.
4) If FinServe needs true 0-retention for all artifacts (including embeddings), we’ll scope impact and pricing and propose an alternate pilot.

If you want, Priya (cc’d) can run a short technical session next week to validate the data flow and hash/redaction approach.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-ephemeral-architecture.pdf (diagram), pilot-mop.xlsx (pilot plan)

From: Samir Gupta <samir@finserve.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Morales <lisa@finserve.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data handling pilot: next steps and scope

Thanks Stephanie — good recap. A couple of clarifying Qs from our side before we sign off internally: 

1) When you say "0-retention for free-text" — does that cover the raw request and the full generated response? We need assurance that neither is written to disk or included in logs accessible to humans.
2) How are embeddings handled? Our product relies on embeddings for similarity search; if those are retained, we need clarity on who has access and how they can be deleted on request.
3) What does the 7-day telemetry include? We need to be sure it won’t contain identifiable tokens or user identifiers.
4) Procurement asked for a sample data flow diagram and an initial SOC/compliance pack (they tend to move slowly).

We prefer to avoid Dedicated capacity if possible (budget constraints) — can the regional eu-west-1 tenancy guarantee be achieved on the hosted plan?

Happy to have Priya run the tech session. Can do a call next Tue or Wed (EU morning).

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Integrations | FinServe Analytics
samir@finserve.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@finserve.ai>, Lisa Morales <lisa@finserve.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data handling pilot: next steps and scope

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. Answers below and a small tweak to the pilot to make procurement comfortable.

1) "0-retention for free-text": For the pilot we can configure the runtime to avoid persisting raw request and response bodies. Technical details: request/response payloads are kept only in-memory for the duration of the request lifecycle and are not written to long-term logs or object storage. For debugging we provide an opt-in temporary capture that is time-bound and manually reviewed only with an access justification.

2) Embeddings: default behavior is to persist embeddings used for retrieval. Options for pilot:
   - Option A (recommended): Persist embeddings for retrieval but store only a hash pointer + minimal metadata (no user identifiers); retention window = 3 days for the pilot.
   - Option B: Do not persist embeddings at all; compute on demand (higher latency/cost).

3) 7-day telemetry: aggregated counters (requests per minute, 95th latency, token consumption totals) and anonymized request ids. No raw prompt text, no user identifiers, no full request/response payloads.

4) Attached: small dataflow SVG (dataflow_diagram.svg) and I’ve uploaded the MOP and the architecture doc to the drive link below. Also attaching a short SOC2 summary we can share with procurement (SOC2-summary.pdf).

Residency: for the hosted eu-west-1 offering we’ll route all processing and short-term telemetry to eu-west-1. If FinServe requires tenant-level physical isolation or a customer-managed VPC, that is offered under Redwood Private / Dedicated and we’ll scope pricing. For the pilot hosted option we guarantee processing in eu-west-1 and will provide documentation that shows region routing.

Doc link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-finserve-pilot

If this reads OK, we’ll prepare a short SOW and PO template. Priya — can you run the technical session Tue 2026-09-29 09:00 CET?

Thanks,
Stephanie

Attachments referenced: dataflow_diagram.svg, SOC2-summary.pdf
Related: https://docusign.com/instance/ABC123-finserve-nda

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data handling pilot: next steps and scope

Stephanie / Priya — a few internal notes before we lock this in with the customer: 

- Confirmed: we can provide a SOC2 summary and screen captures of controls; full evidence will require a data request and an NDA/procurement milestone.
- Redaction/Hashing: we need clear language in the SOW about what we guarantee (hash-only storage vs reversible pseudonymization). For customer troubleshooting we can offer a manual "capture" process that requires approval and is logged.
- EU residency: verify with infra team that the hosted eu-west-1 routing is enforced for all components (edge, caching, logs). If any component falls outside that region we should call it out in the SOW.
- Suggest we offer a 3-day embeddings retention for pilot (less friction for FinServe) and include an explicit opt-out clause. If FinServe later requests embeddings=0-retention we should treat that as a contract amendment with cost impact.

I’m attaching a short SOC2 artifact summary (SOC2-summary.pdf) and will draft recommended SOW language for the retention clauses for Stephanie to send to procurement.

Marcus
Head of Solutions Security | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Samir Gupta <samir@finserve.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Lisa Morales <lisa@finserve.ai>
Cc: procurement@finserve.ai
Date: 2026-09-23T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data handling pilot: next steps and scope

Stephanie / Marcus — this looks good. Procurement reviewed the SOC2 summary and the MOP; two quick asks from their side before we issue the PO:

1) Please send the short SOW language that clearly states: eu-west-1 processing, ephemeral free-text (no persisted bodies), 3-day embeddings retention for the pilot, and a manual capture process for troubleshooting that requires customer approval.
2) Provide the PO template (we’ll fill and return).

We can proceed with a 4-week pilot under those conditions. Target kick-off: Mon 2026-10-05. Please put Priya down for the tech session next Tue 2026-09-29 09:00 CET.

Thanks — Samir

Attachments: PO_template.pdf
